item.title: U.S. Strikes Iran After Iran Fires on Ship in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Iran’s Calculated Risk

In a brazen display of military might, Iran fired on a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway that connects the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman. The attack, which occurred mere hours after a high-level meeting between Iran’s foreign minister and his Omani counterpart, has sparked a swift and deadly response from the United States. U.S. military forces launched a retaliatory strike on Iranian targets, marking a significant escalation in a long-standing conflict.
